linked_prs.title: [Enhance] Support pruning tool call messages in `ChatAgent` to save token budget
linked_prs.body:
## Description

closes #2758

When the `ChatAgent` calls a tool, a new message from the assisstant with the tool call is pushed to the context window. The arguments of the function calling could get quite long, hindering the speed and token budget. The new mode enables replacing the arguments with a placeholder "[PRUNED]" to save some token space. This happens AFTER the tool is called and the response is recieved. 

**Before:**
```python
[{'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a math specialist equipped with mathematical tools. When given mathematical problems, you MUST use your available math tools (add, sub, multiply, divide) to perform calculations. Always use the appropriate tool function for the operation requested.'}, 
{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Calculate 156 * 78'}, 
>>>{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '', 'tool_calls': [{'id': 'call_YAoghcNkYigmVvdeE60Qwdtw', 'type': 'function', 'function': {'name': 'multiply', 'arguments': '{"a": 156, "b": 78, "decimal_places": 2}'}}]}, 
{'role': 'tool', 'content': '12168', 'tool_call_id': 'call_YAoghcNkYigmVvdeE60Qwdtw'}]
```

**Now:**
```python
[{'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a math specialist equipped with mathematical tools. When given mathematical problems, you MUST use your available math tools (add, sub, multiply, divide) to perform calculations. Always use the appropriate tool function for the operation requested.'}, 
{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Calculate 156 * 78'}, 
>>>{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '', 'tool_calls': [{'id': 'call_QUcP7JoqruwRuiwVmplgriij', 'type': 'function', 'function': {'name': 'multiply', 'arguments': '"[PRUNED]"'}}]}, 
{'role': 'tool', 'content': '12168', 'tool_call_id': 'call_QUcP7JoqruwRuiwVmplgriij'}]
```

_**Why not remove the tool call message completely?**_
We also want to keep the agent's messages coherent. It would look odd for the agent to receive tool outputs without calling them.

**_We need an enhanced memory_**
After modifying the message, updating it in the memory is quite challenging with the current memory implementation. Without an update method, we just have to modify the specific record, clear the memory, and push new record along with all of the other records.
